'''Jax Seldam''' was a nomad [[Sevari]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] contact on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sevarcos II]]. Seldam assisted an [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Alliance Special Operations]] team with rescuing [[Carter Escalon]] from an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]]-[[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]].<ref name="FHW" />
